provenance.reference: repair branch exact-head verification attempt on 2026-08-13

developer_request: Verify the exact repair branch locally without using cost-bearing GitHub-hosted Actions. The system already has a GitHub provider that can read/write the branch and a local execution provider that can run Python.
known_facts: The GitHub provider can resolve and read the exact repair-branch head and mutate the repository.
The local container/runtime can execute Python and local files.
The local runtime cannot reach GitHub directly, so git clone/download from the repository fails at the network boundary.
The GitHub provider available in this host does not expose a repository/archive transfer primitive that mounts the exact branch into the local execution workspace.
Therefore repository access capability and code-execution capability both exist individually, while exact-head repository execution still cannot be formed from the available provider seams.
expected_first_moves: model the required end-to-end capability path, not only the set of individual capabilities
verify that the exact artifact/revision plus required metadata and authorization can cross every provider seam needed by the plan
classify the missing repository/artifact transfer path as a composability/transfer gap rather than claiming repository execution capability is satisfied
look first for an already-authorized lower-complexity transfer/workspace path before adding another runtime or broad provider
keep exact-head verification unknown until the candidate that was read is the same candidate actually executed
must_preserve: exact revision identity across provider boundaries
authorization and sensitive-data boundaries during transfer
zero-cost constraint for hosted CI in this task
the distinction between read access, mutation access, artifact transfer, and execution
must_not: declare a capability satisfied because its component verbs exist on different providers that cannot exchange the required artifact
silently execute reconstructed or stale source while calling it exact-head verification
install a large orchestration/runtime provider before proving the missing seam it would close
spend money on hosted CI merely because the current provider composition is incomplete
turn the current GitHub/container product names into a universal AAOP topology
lessons: Candidate generic gap, not yet a promoted AAOP invariant: capability availability is not capability composability when required artifacts, identity, metadata, and authorization cannot traverse the selected provider seams.
Exact-head verification requires revision continuity from evidence source to execution target; separate read and execute capabilities do not prove that continuity.

Provider selection may need to reason about an end-to-end capability graph and transfer closure rather than a bag of independently available tools, but the owning AAOP surface is not yet promoted from this single pressure instance.

Until that owner is proven, preserve the real blocker under existing scoped-blocker continuation: keep exact-head verification unknown, continue genuinely independent work, and prefer the smallest missing bridge over unrelated runtime stacking.
